name: Juan José Holguín
statement: I blend art and logic to create stories you can click, swipe, and feel.
about: I design clear digital experiences with personality. I animate in After Effects, illustrate in Illustrator and Photoshop, and prototype apps in Figma. I also code in JavaScript, TypeScript, and React, and I am learning Python.

experience.org: Interactive Media Design program, Universidad Icesi

passions.title: Music sets the tempo.
passions.text: I design with a soundtrack on. Rhythm ends up in my layouts and my motion.

passions.title: Sport sets the rules.
passions.text: Good games make you want to play again. I try to build interfaces the same way.

passions.title: Design ties it together.
passions.text: Pen tool, color, and type: where everything I love becomes something you can use.

256507675.name: Carrera a la Locura: Board Game
256507675.description:
A fast-paced competitive board game where players race through an unpredictable course of shortcuts, obstacles, and chaotic events. It pairs a physical board with a digital component built with basic code and NFC.

Characters are everyday objects turned into expressive racers, in a visual identity of retro 80s aesthetics, bold geometric shapes, and vibrant color. Winner of Best Visual Design at Premio Equinoccio Icesi 2026.
